Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, d As Object, o As Object, co As Object, ch As Object, n As Object, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set d = wb.Worksheets(1): d.Name = "Data"
    Set o = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=d): o.Name = "Other": d.Activate
    d.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    d.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    d.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    Set co = d.ChartObjects.Add(300, 100, 300, 200): Set ch = co.Chart
    ch.SetSourceData d.Range("A1:C4"), xlColumns
    ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartTitle.Text = "t"
    ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    ch.SeriesCollection(2).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280
    d.Range("A1").Select
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set n = co.Duplicate: r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 1
        r = TypeName(co.Duplicate)
    Case 2
        Set n = d.Shapes(1).Duplicate.DrawingObject: r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 3
        r = TypeName(d.Shapes(1).Duplicate)
    Case 4
        co.Duplicate: Set n = co.Duplicate: r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 5
        Set n = co.Duplicate: Set n = n.Duplicate: r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 6
        co.Name = "Mine": Set n = co.Duplicate: r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 7
        co.Left = 10: co.Top = 20: Set n = co.Duplicate: r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 8
        Set n = co.Duplicate: n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text = "other": r = ch.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 9
        Set n = co.Duplicate: n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 10
        Set n = co.Duplicate: d.Rows(1).Insert: r = n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 11
        Set n = co.Duplicate: d.Name = "Moved": r = n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 12
        Set n = co.Duplicate: n.Delete: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 13
        Set n = co.Duplicate: co.Delete: r = d.ChartObjects(1).Name
    Case 14
        r = TypeName(d.ChartObjects.Duplicate)
    Case 15
        d.ChartObjects.Duplicate: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 16
        d.ChartObjects.Add 5, 5, 50, 50: d.ChartObjects.Duplicate: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 17
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: ch.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text = "v": co.Duplicate: r = d.ChartObjects(2).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Count
    Case 18
        ch.Legend.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: co.Duplicate: r = d.ChartObjects(2).Chart.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 19
        r = co.Copy
    Case 20
        r = d.Shapes(1).Copy
    Case 21
        co.Copy: d.Paste: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 22
        co.Copy: d.Range("H20").Select: d.Paste: Set n = d.ChartObjects(2): r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 23
        co.Copy: d.Range("H20").Select: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): Set n = d.ChartObjects(2): r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 24
        co.Copy: d.Paste Destination:=d.Range("A10"): Set n = d.ChartObjects(2): r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 25
        d.Shapes(1).Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): Set n = d.ChartObjects(2): r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 26
        co.Copy: o.Paste o.Range("B2"): Set n = o.ChartObjects(1): r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula & " " & d.ChartObjects.Count & " " & ActiveSheet.Name
    Case 27
        co.Copy: o.Activate: o.Range("B2").Select: o.Paste: Set n = o.ChartObjects(1): r = n.Name & " " & n.Left & " " & n.Top & " " & n.Width & " " & n.Height & " " & n.Index & " " & n.ZOrder & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & n.Chart.ChartTitle.Text & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 28
        co.Copy: r = TypeName(d.Paste(d.Range("A10")))
    Case 29
        co.Copy: d.Range("A10").PasteSpecial: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 30
        co.Copy: d.Range("A10").Select: d.PasteSpecial: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 31
        co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): r = TypeName(Selection)
    Case 32
        co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): d.Paste d.Range("A30"): r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 33
        co.Copy: co.Delete: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): r = d.ChartObjects.Count & d.ChartObjects(1).Name
    Case 34
        r = Application.CutCopyMode: co.Copy: r = r & " " & Application.CutCopyMode
    Case 35
        ch.ChartArea.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 36
        ch.Copy
    Case 37
        r = d.Shapes(1).Cut
    Case 38
        d.Shapes(1).Cut: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 39
        d.Shapes(1).Cut: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): r = d.ChartObjects.Count & d.ChartObjects(1).Name & d.ChartObjects(1).Left
    Case 40
        d.Shapes(1).Cut: o.Paste o.Range("A10"): r = d.ChartObjects.Count & o.ChartObjects.Count & o.ChartObjects(1).Name
    Case 41
        co.Cut: r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 42
        co.Cut: d.Paste d.Range("A10"): r = d.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 43
        d.Copy After:=d: Set n = wb.Worksheets(2).ChartObjects(1): r = n.Name & " " & n.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula & " " & wb.Worksheets(2).Name
    Case 44
        d.Copy After:=d: r = wb.Worksheets(2).ChartObjects(1).Chart.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 45
        o.Range("A1").Value = 1: d.Copy Before:=o: r = wb.Worksheets(2).Name & wb.Worksheets(2).ChartObjects.Count
    Case 46
        d.Copy After:=o: wb.Worksheets(3).Rows(1).Insert: r = wb.Worksheets(3).ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 47
        d.Copy After:=d: d.Range("B2").Value = 9: r = wb.Worksheets(2).ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Values()(1)
    Case 48
        o.ChartObjects.Add 1, 1, 100, 100: o.ChartObjects(1).Chart.SetSourceData d.Range("A1:B4"): o.Copy After:=o: r = wb.Worksheets(3).ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 49
        d.Copy: r = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Formula: ActiveWorkbook.Close False
    Case 50
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 51
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 52
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 53
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(2).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 54
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 55
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(2).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 56
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).HasDataLabel = True: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 57
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).HasDataLabel = True: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 58
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: d.Range("D1:D4").Value = 1: ch.SetSourceData d.Range("A1:D4"), xlColumns: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 59
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    Case 60
        ch.ClearToMatchStyle: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Delete: co.Copy: d.Paste d.Range("A10")
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = d.ChartObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.ChartObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = wb.Worksheets.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ActiveSheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(Selection)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.ChartTitle.Text
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = d.Shapes.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
